data.title: Padding
data.tagline: Create space between a box and its content
data.description: Padding adds room inside an element, between its border and its content. It affects the visible size and click area of buttons, cards, and panels. Keep repeated components on the same spacing scale so they feel related.

use: Give a button a comfortable click area
Keep card content away from the edge
avoid: Use padding to separate two independent components
Shrink a control below a comfortable target size
Use different inner spacing for identical items
Add spaces to text instead of styling the container

lessonPractice.title: Button text touches the border and the hit area is too small, while spacing to nearby elements is already correct. What should change?

options.label: Increase horizontal and vertical button padding and recheck the control size
options.feedback: Padding separates text from the border and expands the button's own hit area without changing external relationships.

options.label: Increase button margin and move the whole button away from nearby text and icons
options.feedback: Margin changes external distance but does not move text away from the border or enlarge the clickable area.

options.label: Only increase text line-height and let the button grow with the line box
options.feedback: Line-height controls the text line box and cannot independently create reliable horizontal space or complete button padding.

data.agentPrompt: Increase horizontal and vertical button padding so text clears the border and the hit area grows, while preserving existing external margin. Test short text, long text, and icon-only buttons for height, side spacing, and click area.
